leadText: Ranmaru (Japanese: ランマル) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.
plainText:
Ranmaru (Japanese: ランマル) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest. 

==In the games==
 , Oichi, , Nō, and Ginchiyo]]
 

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 60% link with Riolu or Lucario while Nobunaga is in the same kingdom.

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Still snoozing..."
With low health or a status ailment:
"Something must be done...!"
When victory is near:
"We're nearly there."
Otherwise:
"I shall step forward!"

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle: 
"It is time to test our faith!"
When defending a castle: 
"We will not go down easily!"

During battle: 
"For the sake of my Lord/Lady ... and Ranmaru are at your service!"

When ordering to attack: 
" , !"

When ordering to go to battle: 
To a kingdom:
"Whoever I might be faced with, you can count on me not to retreat!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Let's set off!"

Upon forming a link: 
"I've linked with ! Right, then! Come along!"

Upon finding Perfect Link:
"Oh, Riolu/Lucario... The way I feel about you, it's... I can't describe it. Do you feel something similar, by any chance? I feel like I can become stronger if you are by my side, Riolu/Lucario! I'm counting on you!"

When using an item: 
"I will use my ."

When using his Warrior Skill: 
"I will give everything for victory!"

After winning a battle: 
If he attacked a castle:
"Forgive us. We simply could not afford to lose."
If he defended a castle:
"We have merely done our duty."

After losing a battle:
If recruitable:
"You may be the enemy, but... I must admit that you are impressive."
When defeated by something other than the enemy:
"No..."
Otherwise:
"I don't care about my own life... But 's is another matter!"

When being recruited:
"If you're sure it's me you want... then I shall gladly accept your proposition!"

When his Pokémon is evolving:
"But...! What's happening to you, ?"

When there are 10 Warriors in the army:
"We are slowly starting to build a fine group of allies! We mustn't stop now... I'm counting on your help, !"

At the start of :
"Why me...?"
"I am a man... But no one will listen!"
"Is anyone going to notice,,,?"
"But I don't want to ruin the contest. Everyone in Ransei is so excited, after all..."
"If only Lord Nobunaga were here..."
"But he has gone away, entrusting me with the castle."
"Well, there is only one thing for it!"
"I must battle as if my very life depended on it!"

At the end of :
"I won, but..."
"Now it's going to be even harder for me to tell the world that I'm a man..."
"Does that really matter, though...?"
"Lord Nobunaga...!"
"Oh..."
"Nothing could make me happier than hearing those words, my lord!"

===Profile===
A courageous and extremely talented Warrior. Earnest and very dutiful, he has no ambitions of his own but to serve his master.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Ranmaru debuted in PNA6.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
Ranmaru is the only male Warrior in the , this happened because he was mistaken for a female.

===Historical origin===
Ranmaru is based on the real-life of Japanese history. He was Nobunaga's page.
